cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in Southern Africa changed by −0.091 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.166 to −0.019), which is statistically significant (p = 0.01). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is a decrease of about 0.224 mm/day.
